name: Entendre
description: Connect Claude to Entendre’s Unified API and work across your accounting data from a single conversation—browse accounts, query transactions, review balances, classify activity, create journal entries, generate reports, and keep your general ledger in sync without exporting data or switching tools.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Entendre to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Entendre to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.entendre.finance/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Entendre MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Entendre provides these MCP tools: list_directory, read_file, and execute_code.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Entendre?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Entendre in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Entendre requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Entendre is developed by Entendre AI. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
